company.name: SandebTech
company.description: SandebTech delivers advanced engineering simulation, Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), hydrodynamic optimization and digital engineering solutions for marine, offshore, defense and industrial sectors.

services.title: Hull Form Optimization
services.description: Optimize vessel hull geometry using Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) to reduce resistance, improve propulsion efficiency and minimize fuel consumption.

services.title: Energy Saving Devices Optimization
services.description: Design and optimize Energy Saving Devices (ESDs) using CFD to improve propulsion efficiency and reduce operational costs.

services.title: Seakeeping Analysis
services.description: Evaluate vessel performance in real sea conditions through advanced seakeeping simulations to improve safety, comfort and operability.

services.title: CFD Engineering Consulting
services.description: Professional CFD consulting services for marine, offshore, industrial and turbomachinery engineering projects.

solutions.title: SHIPFLOW CFD
solutions.description: SHIPFLOW is a specialized CFD solution for ship resistance prediction, propulsion analysis, self-propulsion simulations and hull optimization.

solutions.title: CAESES
solutions.description: CAESES is a powerful parametric CAD and design optimization platform enabling automated engineering workflows and CFD-driven optimization.

solutions.title: Lotus Marine
solutions.description: Lotus Marine delivers advanced marine engineering solutions for offshore structures, vessel dynamics and seakeeping analysis.

solutions.title: Turbomachinery
solutions.description: Advanced turbomachinery simulation and optimization for pumps, compressors, turbines and rotating equipment.

faq.answer: SandebTech is an engineering consulting company specializing in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), marine engineering, digital engineering and simulation-driven product development.
SandebTech is headquartered in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.
Project pricing depends on the scope, complexity and engineering effort. Contact our team for a customized quotation.
We provide engineering consulting, implementation, training and support for SHIPFLOW and CAESES software solutions.
You can schedule a technical consultation with our engineering specialists.
